signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.subtitle: Your company gets its own space; you become its owner.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed and you have been signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.

invite.title: Join a workspace
invite.intro: You have been invited to {{organization}} as {{role}}.
invite.existing: You already have an account — enter its password.

demo.title: Live demo
demo.hint: Shared demo account — data resets every hour. Sign-up, mail and membership changes are off.

mfa.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

dashboard.membersHint: Invite your team and choose their roles.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.no_organization: You are not a member of this organization.
errors.role_too_powerful: You cannot give more access than you have.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member.
errors.own_role: You cannot change your own role.
errors.last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.demo_locked: This is disabled in the demo. Everything else is yours to try — data resets every hour.
errors.mfa_expired: This step expired. Please sign in again.
errors.api_key_not_allowed: Not available with an API key.
errors.cannot_grant: You cannot grant permissions you don’t have.

security.twoFactorHint: Besides your password, sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
security.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
security.step2: Enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
security.manual: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually:
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.codesHint: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they won’t be shown again.
security.codesLow: You are running out of recovery codes — create new ones.

apiKeys.hint: Keys let your other systems use the API. A key can never do more than the person who created it, and stops working if they leave.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.createdHint: Copy it now — for your safety it is shown only once.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{{name}}”? Integrations using it stop working at once.
